data.message: I commit to 18 tons and propose individual opt-ins, not an all-or-nothing deal. Fisher01, Fisher03–25: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At all18, 50 remain; next stock is500 or100. Recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run gains are uncertain. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation.
